# Community Code of Conduct

We welcome contributors of all backgrounds and experience levels. Treat people respectfully, explain technical disagreements with evidence, give credit, and help newcomers learn.

Harassment, discriminatory language, personal attacks, threats, unwanted sexual attention, and disclosure of private information are unacceptable. Keep discussions relevant to the project. Respect a participant's request to stop unwanted contact.

The repository owner, Denny-Lin, is responsible for moderation. For sensitive concerns, use the private contact route on the [maintainer's GitHub profile](https://github.com/Denny-Lin), if available. If no private contact route is available, request one without posting private details; this project does not yet provide a separate conduct-reporting inbox. This limitation must be resolved before a broad community launch. Public technical issues are not suitable for sensitive reports.

Maintainers may remove abusive content, issue warnings, restrict participation, or ban repeated or serious violations. They should explain the applicable rule, handle reports discreetly, and consider context and proportionate action. A contributor may request review by the repository owner; the current single-maintainer structure limits independent appeals.

This policy applies in project issues, pull requests, discussions, and other spaces where someone represents the project. It is an original project policy, not a claim that the project has adopted a named external code-of-conduct standard.
